Steamed now runs on **Minecraft 26.3**, on Fabric, NeoForge and Quilt.

### New

- **Minecraft 26.3** on Fabric, NeoForge and Quilt. Everything that works on 26.2 works the same here
- **ViaFabric support.** If you have [ViaFabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/viafabric) installed, you can join a host on a
  different Minecraft version. The friends' lobbies list no longer greys those lobbies out for you, and Steamed tells
  ViaFabric the host's version up front instead of letting it probe the connection

| Jar | Minecraft | Also needs |
|---|---|---|
| `steamed-fabric-0.2.2+26.3.jar` | 26.3 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-neoforge-0.2.2+26.3.jar` | 26.3 | Kotlin for Forge 6.4+ |
| `steamed-quilt-0.2.2+26.3.jar` | 26.3 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-fabric-0.2.2+26.2.jar` | 26.2 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-neoforge-0.2.2+26.2.jar` | 26.2 | Kotlin for Forge 6.4+ |
| `steamed-quilt-0.2.2+26.2.jar` | 26.2 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-fabric-0.2.2+1.21.1.jar` | 1.21, 1.21.1 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-neoforge-0.2.2+1.21.1.jar` | 1.21.1 | Kotlin for Forge 5.12+ |
| `steamed-fabric-0.2.2+1.20.1.jar` | 1.20.1 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-forge-0.2.2+1.20.1.jar` | 1.20.1 | Kotlin for Forge 4.12+ |

### Good to know

- Without ViaFabric, players on different Minecraft versions still can't join each other
- This only helps the player who is joining, and only on Fabric or Quilt, since ViaFabric is a Fabric mod
- Joining across two Steam accounts hasn't been tested on 26.3 yet, and neither has joining through ViaFabric
- Everyone in a lobby still needs the same Steamed version, so update together with your friends
